headline: Kenya Railways Targets Car Dealers with New SGR Freight Service
summary: Kenya Railways has launched a vehicle transport service on the Standard Gauge Railway to move vehicles for car dealers and importers.
why: Rail freight infrastructure developments lower logistics costs and improve supply chain efficiency for automotive imports in East Africa.

impacts.name: Freight Transportation
impacts.why: New rail transport service expands options for vehicle importers.
